Home.title: Data Scientist & Consultant
Home.bio: With a Master's degree from the University of Tokyo, I now work at Mitsubishi Research Institute, where I focus on data science and AI consulting in the financial sector — solving complex business challenges with data and generative AI. Before that, I delivered Salesforce-based digital transformation consulting and implementation at Deloitte. Outside of work, I build quirky side projects and travel across all 47 prefectures of Japan and beyond, documenting my journey through the lens of my camera.

lines: Hi, I'm Muse — Zeli's little agent.
I look after this site. Let me keep you company while you browse.
Poke me and I'll make a face — poke again for another one.
Curious about Zeli? Tap me, then hit “Ask Muse” — I remember it all.
Drag me onto the bubble above and we can play Muse Dash.
You can also drag me anywhere and leave me there. I don't mind.

MiniGame.title: Muse Dash
MiniGame.howTo:
📖 Last night a data storm scattered ALL of this homepage's data! Muse has 45 seconds to charge upward and gather it all back.
🎮 Drag her (or use the arrow keys) to run anywhere in the field:
• Golden motes are important data, +30 pts
• Plain motes are ordinary data, +10 pts
• Ink blobs are garbled data, −20 pts if you brush one
• The purple spiky ones are viruses, −1 life on contact
• The brick walls lying across are fallen firewalls: solid — hit one from below and it stops you and carries you down, so slip around the gaps at their ends or in the middle
• Getting pushed off the screen also costs 1 life
💪 3 lives. The farther you run and the more you gather, the higher the score. Charge — bring the homepage's data home!
MiniGame.labCardDesc: A data storm scattered the homepage's data! Charge upward with Muse for 45 seconds, slip around the fallen firewalls, and gather it all back.

home.intro: You made it! This is Zeli's personal homepage — I'm Muse, his little agent. Happy to show you around.
guide: The cards above lead to his profile, the lab, and the travel albums; the guestbook is in the menu up top too.
Not sure where to start? Try the travel albums — the snow festivals and Morioka noodles are worth it.
Tap me and choose “Ask Muse” to ask me directly; I'll help you find any page.

profile.intro: This page is Zeli's profile — his education and career history, all in one place.
feel: Deloitte to Mitsubishi Research Institute — a steady path. I rather admire it.
A master's from the University of Tokyo; he's this thorough about everything.
A serious page, but every line of it is real.

lab.intro: Welcome to the lab! Zeli's home-made tools and plugins live here — plus a little game.
feel: All built after work, bit by bit. Quality aside, the effort is genuine.
The lab also hides a game starring me — Muse Dash. Give it a try.
What I like about him: when he gets an idea, he just builds it.

travels.intro: The travel albums. Zeli has visited all 47 prefectures of Japan, and these were shot on his Fujifilm X-S20.
feel: I've been through every album many times; the snowy one is my favourite.
Every place in these photos is somewhere he actually went — all 47 prefectures.
Open any album and take your time; each photo comes with a caption.
